non_marginalized_version_invalid_for_cur.reason: The non-CMB-marginalized dataset requires TT, EE, TE and PP theory. PP-only theory cannot evaluate its CMB-dependent correction and produced an invalid large baseline chi-squared.
non_marginalized_version_invalid_for_cur.result_use: not used for any physical conclusion and not presented as a valid likelihood

official_crosscheck_initial_format_failu.reason: CosmoMC readWithHeader requires a commented theory header; the initial 'L PP' header lacked '#'.
official_crosscheck_initial_format_failu.resolution: v3 writes '# L PP' in a separate theory directory

v3.scope: Only the official CMB-marginalized lensing-only dataset, which requires PP and has no calibration parameter

boundaries: No parameter fitting, posterior, or model-family exclusion.
Earlier invalid non-marginalized outputs are not deleted or used as valid evidence.
The valid v3 analysis still requires independent CosmoMC cross-verification before any physical interpretation.
